head: cloud/docs-top-p-zero
title: docs(server): allow top_p zero and scope cache_prompt to its endpoints
body:
This PR fixes two documentation statements that disagree with the code on `main`:

- `docs/SERVER.md` said "explicit zero values are preserved (`top_p` must remain positive)". The same file says later that "Top-p zero keeps the highest-probability token". The request range check in `src/cli/serve/sampling_request.hpp` accepts `top_p` in `[0, 1]`, and `src/core/sampling.cpp` rejects only values outside `[0, 1]`. The stale clause came from #282. #332 later fixed the sampling ranges and added the top-p zero sentence. The sentence now reads "explicit zero values, including `top_p: 0`, are preserved".
- `docs/KV-CACHE.md` said `cache_prompt: false` bypasses lookup without naming an endpoint. Only the Chat Completions and Responses parsers read `cache_prompt` (`openai_chat.cpp`). The sentence now names those two routes, as `docs/SERVER.md` already does.

A related point, left out of this docs-only PR: `/v1/messages`, `/v1/completions` and `/completion` accept a `cache_prompt` field without an error and ignore it. I can follow up by honoring it or rejecting it, whichever you prefer.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending (docs only; nothing to validate on hardware).

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope: `python3 tools/ci/check-docs.py` passed on a CPU host: 87 markdown files and 475 local links/anchors, none broken. I confirmed the code statements above by reading source on `main` (665fc18). No build or other tests ran, because only documentation changes.
